summary: Providence merchant and patriot, a founding proprietor of Hudson, New York, and its recorder and mayor; John's 3rd cousin 8x removed.
bio:
David Lawrence was born at Newport, Rhode Island, on 18 February 1738, the seventh son of John Lawrence, a Newport and Providence shipowner born in 1703, who was a son of Joseph Lawrence and a grandson of William Lawrence and Elizabeth Smith; he is John's 3rd cousin eight times removed. His brother Joseph Lawrence, born in 1729, wrote the first marine insurance policy in Rhode Island.

David married about 1763 at Providence. A Providence merchant and patriot, described as 'the intimate friend of Benjamin Franklin', he named a son after Samuel Adams. In 1783 he moved to Hudson, New York, as one of its thirty founding proprietors, and he served the new city as recorder and mayor. He died at Hudson on 18 October 1809.
sources: [R4-S1] Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), pp. 55-56 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historicalgeneal00lawr
